dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures featuring thin, irregular, high-contrast light-colored perimeters with jagged edges, containing mottled darker interiors. The most prominent structures exhibit sharp transitions between the dark base pelt and the light boundary lines.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters; small, isolated punctate marks are concentrated primarily in the lower ventral-lateral region and anterior to the pectoral flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent central annuli form a scalene triangle. A secondary alignment of smaller rings in the upper mid-section forms an irregular linear sequence of four keypoints.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral flipper displays five distinct, dark ungual processes with prominent specular highlights against the surrounding fur.
